description: Defines the MultiThreadedProxyResolverFactory class for creating proxy resolvers that operate on multiple threads, including thread management and proxy script handling logic.

classes.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolverFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates proxy resolver instances running on multiple threads, managing thread pool size and script context duplication.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A private nested class representing individual proxy resolver creation jobs.

methods.name: CreateProxyResolver
methods.description: Creates a new proxy resolver instance with the provided PAC script, callback, and request.

methods.name: CreateProxyResolverFactory
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a new ProxyResolverFactory for each thread.

methods.name: RemoveJob
methods.description: Removes a Job instance from the factory's job set.
